# Day-ahead models: all variants, test period (generated by `scripts/analyze_completion.py`; completion batch)

Task: forecasts issued at 10:00 on day D-1 for the 24 hours of day D (`docs/experiment_protocol.md`, entries of 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20). 8,611 (day, hour) samples, 355 complete days; all models are compared on the same samples. Single test evaluations with frozen configurations; tuning budgets differ between models (pooled XGBoost 30 trials, pooled LSTM 30, 24-output LSTM 30, LightGBM 30, GRU 12; ridge and the naive baselines are searched exhaustively or not tuned).
Intervals: 95% paired moving-block bootstrap over whole days (blocks of 28 days, 1,000 resamples).

## 90% prediction intervals for the day-ahead forecasts

Calibrated on the validation period only; rolling conformal uses only errors of forecasts whose target time is not later than the origin (10:00 on the previous day). Coverage target 90%; interval score = width + 20 x the miss distance (lower is better).

| point forecast | method | coverage % | mean width (MW) | interval score (MW) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| XGBoost S4, pooled | split conformal (absolute) | 87.7 | 16,143 | 27,966 |
| XGBoost S4, pooled | rolling conformal (last 720 errors known at the origin) | 89.1 | 17,308 | 28,149 |
| Ridge | split conformal (absolute) | 84.1 | 16,423 | 29,349 |
| Ridge | rolling conformal (last 720 errors known at the origin) | 89.5 | 19,618 | 29,049 |
| LSTM L4, pooled | split conformal (absolute) | 85.6 | 17,478 | 31,671 |
| LSTM L4, pooled | rolling conformal (last 720 errors known at the origin) | 89.0 | 19,895 | 31,097 |
| XGBoost S4, pooled | quantile regression, raw 5%-95% | 83.7 | 15,378 | 29,813 |
| XGBoost S4, pooled | quantile regression + CQR | 87.5 | 17,189 | 29,048 |

## Caveats

- 355 complete days from one test period; intervals reflect day-to-day noise inside the period, not year-to-year variation. The test year has been used several times for declared analyses.
- Scenario A (no forecast weather) except where labelled; the issue time and the availability of the 10:00 demand value are design assumptions.
- XGBoost, LightGBM, the LSTMs and the GRU are pooled over the 24 target hours except where labelled (one model per hour; 24 outputs); tuning budgets differ (see above).
- Statistical models (SARIMAX, Prophet) and convolutional or attention-based networks (TCN, Transformer) were not evaluated (dropped by the owner before any run).
- S6 uses archived temperature forecasts whose issue times were not verified; S5 uses oracle weather and is an upper bound, not an achievable result.
